coverage: Every tracked file at audit start; L1 drafts separately listed in README.md

modern-infrastructure.origin: New project launcher, server, build/deployment/config/test infrastructure; AI-assisted history, not a historic artwork grant.
modern-infrastructure.creator: Project owner/AI assistance; exact human expressive contributions and applicable agreements not independently proven.
modern-infrastructure.permission: No general license currently granted; proposed MIT only for rights actually held.
modern-infrastructure.authority: Conditional MIT candidate, not a certified exclusive-copyright finding.
modern-infrastructure.action: Owner confirms authority/contributions; preserve any upstream snippets/notices; adopt explicitly scoped MIT only after approval.

modern-browser.origin: New browser adapters, storage, repair UI and software-profile implementation informed by legacy behavior and independent evidence.
modern-browser.creator: Project owner/AI assistance; see file comments and history.
modern-browser.license: Currently unlicensed; embedded legacy text/data may require separate scope.
modern-browser.authority: Conditional MIT candidate for independently authored portions only.
modern-browser.action: Review mixed literals/data and line-level derivation; exclude recovered content from modern-code grant.

legacy-port.origin: Direct or behavior-guided port of original ActionScript/render/editor/XML logic.
legacy-port.creator: Senocular/Trevor McCauley likely for historical expression; new adaptation by project/AI.
legacy-port.license: Exact older-source reusable grant unestablished. Later 2009 My Avatar Editor MIT is evidence for specific later files, not blanket retroactive permission.
legacy-port.permission: Modification/redistribution/web hosting of inherited expression unresolved.
legacy-port.authority: Do not represent whole file as solely owner-licensed MIT yet.
legacy-port.action: Obtain permission for old version, document exact match to a licensed later component with retained notices, or independently reimplement functional rules without copying expression.

historical-vectors.origin: Recovered SOURCE/assets.swf and SOURCE/classicGUI.swf vectors/timelines/registration/color data; generated, not original new artwork.
historical-vectors.creator: Historical editor author and potentially Nintendo/other artists; allocations unverified.
historical-vectors.license: No reusable license established for exact source SWFs.
historical-vectors.authority: Owner cannot unilaterally MIT historical graphics.
historical-vectors.action: Separate asset notice and permission; replace with independently owned/licensed art or omit complete graphical distribution if rights cannot be established.

historical-data.origin: Data generated from original ActionScript: fields/permutations/default records/renderer rules/cases.
historical-data.creator: Historical source author; portions are factual interoperability data, not assumed protected or unprotected wholesale.
historical-data.license: No exact-source grant established; facts/functional rules need separate legal characterization.
historical-data.permission: Unresolved for expressive selections/arrangement; no blanket grant inferred.
historical-data.authority: Do not license all generated content solely as new MIT code.
historical-data.action: Trace independently verifiable format facts, preserve provenance, separate generator code from inherited output, seek component clearance where expression is retained.

historical-presets.origin: Default Boy/Girl records from historical site/ClassicGUI; binary appearance and identity input snapshots.
historical-presets.creator: Historical application/site record authors unconfirmed; not new artwork.
historical-presets.license: No explicit record reuse grant identified.
historical-presets.permission: Unresolved; small factual record values may differ legally from art but no blanket conclusion.
historical-presets.authority: MIT may cover new loading/ID-allocation code, not an asserted ownership of inherited record/art.
historical-presets.action: Retain source hashes, avoid personal ID claims, request clarification or derive independently owned defaults if needed.

reference-fixtures.origin: Historical user-supplied Mii records, AS-derived rules, synthetic Phase7 data and independent decoder observations.
reference-fixtures.creator: User/source/reference authors as applicable; factual/synthetic parts not a claim to original-art rights.
reference-fixtures.license: Mixed factual data and own test code; upstream reference scopes separate.
reference-fixtures.permission: Needs per-record/source distinction; no proprietary NAND/game files included.
reference-fixtures.authority: Own assertions/wrappers are MIT candidates; do not assert ownership of all source data.
reference-fixtures.action: Retain corpus provenance and synthetic labels; exclude inherited expressions from blanket MIT scope.

screenshots.origin: Browser screenshots of renderer and historical-derived interface; new capture does not create underlying-art rights.
screenshots.creator: Capture by project/AI browser tooling; original assets retain respective holders.
screenshots.license: No comprehensive image reuse permission established.
screenshots.permission: Rights to depicted artwork/GUI/glyphs remain unresolved even if capture is new.
screenshots.authority: Cannot offer entire image as exclusively new MIT material.
screenshots.action: Clear underlying rights or replace/remove illustrations when needed; license capture contributions separately only if owned.

third-party-notices.origin: Copied upstream license texts for Vite/bundled dependencies and Nginx Unprivileged.
third-party-notices.creator: Named upstream copyright holders.
third-party-notices.license: As stated in each file (MIT/multiple permissive notices; Apache-2.0).
third-party-notices.permission: Follow each upstream license; not owner-created MIT.
third-party-notices.authority: Preserve upstream terms, do not relicense notices wholesale.
third-party-notices.action: Retain complete texts; supplement Docker package obligations and source access.

reference-tools.origin: New analysis harness calling independent external tools; reference source fetched only on explicit request, not bundled.
reference-tools.creator: Own wrapper contributions plus external sources identified in references.
reference-tools.license: Own wrappers unlicensed; MiiJS pinned metadata ISC; RFL repo CC0 declaration; Java Util license unestablished.
reference-tools.permission: Do not infer third-party/Nintendo clearance from repository declarations; no production bundling.
reference-tools.authority: Wrapper portions conditional MIT candidates; external work cannot be relicensed by owner.
reference-tools.action: Keep external sources outside distribution; document pin/license uncertainty and obtain permission before any redistribution.

project-docs.origin: AI-assisted factual project documentation, configs and notices; contains third-party names/links and occasional historical-derived examples.
project-docs.creator: Project contributions; cannot distinguish human/AI creativity by Git author label.
project-docs.license: Currently unlicensed except separately identified third-party material.
project-docs.permission: Proposed MIT for eligible prose/config only; quotes/assets excluded.
project-docs.authority: Conditional for rights actually held, not new ownership of facts or third-party quotes.
project-docs.action: Keep legal disclosures and rights inventory; use scope/AI statement and separate third-party attribution.
